governance.heading: Interaction governance
governance.anyoneDefaultEffect: New cards are open — the board or any agent can respond, including the one that asked.
governance.noCapEffect: A request keeps whatever audience it asks for.
governance.newCardsExcludeCreator: New cards exclude the agent that created them, so the answer comes from someone else.
governance.newCardsHumanOnly: New cards wait for a person on the board. Agents are turned away.
governance.capExcludesCreator: Even a card that asks for Anyone is narrowed to exclude its creator.
governance.capHumanOnly: Every card of this kind waits for a person, whatever it asked for.
governance.description: Thread interactions are open by default: <emphasis>Anyone</emphasis> in the organization — the board or any agent, including the one that asked — can respond. Narrow a kind only when you need to. <emphasis>Default policy</emphasis> is the audience new cards get when the requester does not ask for one; <emphasis>Cap</emphasis> narrows every request of that kind and can never widen one. Tool-approval confirmations always stay <emphasis>Human only</emphasis>.
